_comment: Every address the launch needs, in one place. Nothing here is a secret — these are all
public on chain the moment anything is deployed. The RPC key is deliberately NOT here:
it belongs behind /api/rpc as a server-side environment variable, because anything this
file contains ends up in the repo and anything the page contains ends up in view-source.
_owner: The only address that may deploy, and where every fee goes. Immutable everywhere it appears.

fees._note: snoozeDev only receives anything if devBps > 0, and above zero supplyOnlyFalls() returns false.

token.name: Snooze Bear
token._devBps: 0 keeps 'supply only falls' exactly true. Up to 2000 is a share OF THE HAIRCUT, never of the trade.

curve._virtualEth: Sets what a comfortable buy is denominated in, NOT how deep the book is. 3e18 = a 0.1 ETH buy moves the price 3.3%.
curve._bondTarget: E0*(sqrt(m)-1). At E0=3 and m=10 that is 6.487 ETH of real buys.
curve._feeBps: 1%, charged in ETH on the way in and the way out, and paid straight to curveFeeTo. Capped at 500 by the contract.

gate._comment: Hold SNOOZE to bid on LAPTOP during the early window. Zero on the SNOOZE curve itself, since there is nothing to hold yet.

vanity._comment: An address is hex, so only 0-9 and a-f exist in one. PUMP, DUMP, BULL, MOON, BEAR and ZZZ all contain letters the alphabet does not have and cannot be ground at any cost.
vanity._reachable: ba5ed (BASED), bada55 (BADASS), 1337 (LEET), 600d (GOOD), beabed (BEA-BED), 5eeded (SEEDED), acce55 (ACCESS), f00d, face, dead, cafe, beef
vanity._ifYouWantAWordThatIsNotHex: It goes in a Base name, not in the address. pump.snoozebear.eth is what a wallet shows people; the hex underneath it can be anything.
vanity._grind: node tools/vanity-par.mjs beabed --deployer <SnoozeDeployer> --inithash <keccak of the real init code>
vanity._warning: The address depends on the exact bytecode AND the constructor arguments. Grind last, after nothing else will change.
